title: Positive Depth Space V Gamma
body_html:
Positive Depth Space V Gamma

Let \(\Gamma\in\mathbf g\) be invertible as an element of \(\operatorname{End}_D(V)\). The space \(V_\Gamma\) is the same underlying right \(D\)-module as \(V\), equipped with the opposite-sign hermitian form \[ \langle v_1,v_2\rangle_{V_\Gamma}=\langle v_1,\Gamma v_2\rangle_V. \]

The point of the definition is moment-map rigidity: if \(V'\) is a target hermitian space of the same \(D\)-dimension and the coset \(\Gamma+\mathbf g_{x,r+}\) is hit by the moment map \(M:V\otimes_D V'\to\mathbf g\), then \(V'\) is isometric to \(V_\Gamma\).
